name: md-scrub
description: Checks every Markdown file Claude writes and removes content you've ruled out, such as third-party legal terms

openrouter_api_key.title: OpenRouter API key
openrouter_api_key.description: For the Jev classifier, which checks Markdown against your topics. Get one at openrouter.ai/keys; checks cost a fraction of a cent per file. md-scrub stays off until you add one.

jev_on_error.title: If Jev is unavailable
jev_on_error.description: If OpenRouter can't be reached. allow: keyword check only, with a notice. block: refuse Markdown writes until it responds.
